cases.why: the golden the node writes: all eleven fields, focal in pixels of the uploaded frame and height the frame it was measured on
an ABSENT focal is 0 = no claim, not a zero-length lens to invert and not a reason to fail the run
a focal without the frame it was measured on implies no lens: focal/height cannot be formed, so the answer is 0 rather than a divide
the node's own 'the fit failed' answer is 0, and the app must draw its default look rather than a 0-degree camera
a truncated body is no lens (0), not a crash: this file is fetched on the completion path, after the cloud is already on disk
